dct_description_sm:
Overview

This feature service contains polygon features representing storm catchments within the service area. It provides a spatial inventory of drainage catchment areas that can be used to support stormwater planning, watershed reference, and asset management workflows.

Feature Content

  • Storm Catchment — A polygon layer that outlines individual catchment areas associated with stormwater drainage. The layer includes identifiers, an area measurement, asset classification, and watershed reference attributes.

Geographic Coverage

The dataset covers the City of Barrie municipal area in southern Ontario, Canada.

Use Cases

  • Stormwater and drainage planning
  • Catchment mapping and watershed reference
  • Asset inventory and operational support
  • GIS visualization and spatial analysis of drainage areas
